purpose: Teach: フロリダ/クリントン/信長/ヘンリー/ハンター/つくば/赤坂/ミクロ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフロリダの旅行記を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to read us his travel journal from Florida.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Slight lift at the end — offering this to Sho as a small gift of time together. Calm, settled voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとクリントン元大統領のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about President Clinton.
lines.style: Quick, bright response. Eager to share his own memory right away. Slightly breathless with the rush of wanting to tell her. Small voice, genuine excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが織田信長の大河ドラマ観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was watching a historical drama about Oda Nobunaga.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost thinking aloud. Noticing what her husband is doing, sharing it as context. Warm but unhurried. Slight pause before the name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとヘンリー王子の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Prince Henry.
lines.style: Same brightness as before but with even more eagerness. Rushing slightly to share this second memory. Small, genuine laugh underneath. Voice rising a touch at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハンターの友達と山に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father went to the mountains with a friend who hunts.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective delivery. Factual but touched with a note of — he's doing his own things, growing in his own ways. Slight trailing-off. Composed but warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとつくば学園都市行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to Tsukuba Science City.
lines.style: Same eager brightness, but slightly slower this time — savoring the memory a little. Still quick to share but with the warmth of something he genuinely enjoyed. Small, satisfied tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが赤坂で重要な打ち合わせをされるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father has an important meeting in Akasaka.
lines.style: Measured, informative. Acknowledging something a little more serious. Still warm but with a thread of — this is grown-up business, this is what he does. Calm, slightly distanced.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとミクロの世界の図鑑見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about the microscopic world.
lines.style: One final eager rush, but deeper this time — the delight in sharing something he found genuinely interesting. Warm, close, almost confiding. Slight breathlessness at the end.
